title: CYCLIC-ROOTLOG: fixed half-log balanced leaf boost and plateau with uniform rational parameters

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the single CYCLIC-ROOTLOG configuration in proof.md and cyclic_base.md fixes gamma=1/2 for every input and all resources and recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 under independent ideal copies. Jointly on every execution branch, its total charged sequential work T is O(n^3 2^(a sqrt(n)+3sqrt(n)/(log2 n))), for the eventually positive representative envelope evaluated at n>=2^64 and extended positively on the finite smaller prefix. All outside constants are absolute, independent of N,s and outcomes. Here , the exact Pell rational u_333/v_333 of cyclic_base.md Section 0. This envelope has exact growth index 1/2. The parameter ell is the explicitly charged rational logarithm of proof.md, and x=s=max(2,isqrt(floor(mu^2/ell))). The below-four retry factor, actual recomputed decoder/extractor parameters and literal Q_star=8 A_star(G_odd+2a2)+2a2, Qcap=1024 Q_star supersede the original fixed16 configuration; the auxiliary family lemma never mixes parameter choices among these joint claims.
